CustomField.description: The framework guard on Opportunity, its second governed object (arch doc 3.2, 3.4, 6.3; M11). Set true by the engine only, in the same transaction as its own submission. Cleared by every template's final approval, final rejection and recall actions. Every Classic template on Opportunity requires it true in entry criteria, so a submission that bypasses the engine fails loudly instead of routing silently. A framework convention, never a configurable name.
CustomField.label: Matrix Submission
